method: Fresh legal public action solver through all 96 main tasks and 14 side deliveries. No resource injection. One fixed policy/seed; virtual waiting is not human playtime.
policy: No material parcels, no regional activities or tea. Claim level/chapter/daily rewards; invest in producers (level2 early, level3 after furnishing) and storage up to16. No resource balance reset.
